author: c4ooo
body: And if not peaceful, how do i prevent mobs from spawning?
body_tagged: And if not peaceful, how do i prevent mobs from spawning?
title: What difficulty should the map be in?

replies.author: Gundham
replies.body:
Please, from now on, refer to this topic if you have a question regarding Map Making:
http://avicus.net/forums/eff6ca1d0

As to your question, difficulty doesn't really matter in your world, as long as mobs are disabled (and not present in the map, as well). You can disable mob spawning by typing /gamerule doMobSpawning false in the chat.
